name: Isoniazid
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Use paracetamol with caution; avoid high doses.
Check carbamazepine levels before and during use; adjust the dose.
Adjust the phenytoin dose to avoid toxicity.

key_interactions.effect: Ketoconazole exposure can fall by up to 88% (label).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Food; tyramine- or histamine-rich foods (cheese, red wine, tuna, skipjack)
key_interactions.effect: Food lowers isoniazid absorption; tyramine or histamine reactions (label).
key_interactions.action: Take on an empty stomach; avoid these foods.
